text: “But you will allow me to say, Mr. McGrath, that I do not quite understand your attitude in the matter. You made no attempt to arouse the hotel? To pursue the thief?” Anthony shrugged his shoulders. “Nothing of value had been taken, as I tell you. I am aware, of course, that strictly speaking it is a case for the police——” He paused, and the manager murmured without any particular enthusiasm: “For the police—of course——” “In any case, I was fairly certain that the man would manage to make good his escape, and since nothing was taken why bother with the police?” The manager smiled a little.
